comment: The mix is summed, high-pass filtered, clamped to 111.7V of headroom, divided by 85 and put through an antiderivative-antialiased polynomial tanh before being scaled by 6.9 and the master volume (PreeeeeeeeeeessedDuck.cpp:1100). The compression divides the summed peak by the number of strips that actually carry a signal (PreeeeeeeeeeessedDuck.cpp:961), so PRESS behaves differently as strips are patched and unpatched. Shift-clicking a mute button solos that strip (PreeeeeeeeeeessedDuck.cpp:772).
